user_query: I want to organize a company conference and send out invitations to clients with verified email addresses and include the company's heartbeat status.

TaskList.description: Collect a list of client email addresses for the invitations.
Verify the validity of the collected email addresses.
Retrieve the company's heartbeat status to include in the emails.
Compose the invitation email, including verified email addresses and the company's heartbeat status.
Send out the composed invitation emails to the verified clients.
